## Overview

Virtual scroll directive that calculates which items should be rendered
based on the viewport size and scroll position.

Apply it to the scrollable container. The consumer is responsible for
rendering the items using `visibleItems()` and setting the content height.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzVirtualScroll`
- **Source:** [packages/core/src/virtual-scroll/virtual-scroll.directive.ts:40](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/core/src/virtual-scroll/virtual-scroll.directive.ts#L40)

## Selector

```text
[qzVirtualScroll]
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `T[]` |  | Yes | Full array of items to virtualize. |
| `itemSize` | `number` |  | Yes | Fixed pixel height of each item. |
| `buffer` | `number` | `5` |  | Extra items to render outside the viewport (default 5). |

| `readonly visibleItems` | `Signal<VirtualScrollRow<T>[]>` | Items currently visible (plus buffer) with their pixel offsets. |
